question: Who is the first law officer of the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Attorney General of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Attorney General of India is the chief legal advisor to the Government of India and the primary lawyer in the Supreme Court of India.
 
• The position of the Attorney General of India is mentioned under Article 76 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Attorney General is appointed by the President of India and holds office during the pleasure of the President.
 
• He/she must be a person qualified to be appointed as a Judge of the Supreme Court.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Attorney General of India:**

 
 
• The Attorney General is responsible for giving advice to the Government of India upon such legal matters, and to perform such other duties of a legal character, as may from time to time be referred or assigned to him by the President.
 
• He also represents the Government of India in all cases in the Supreme Court in which the Government of India is concerned.
 
• In the performance of his official duties, the Attorney General has the right of audience in all courts in the territory of India.
 
• The current Attorney General of India, as of the latest update, is R. Venkataramani.
 
 
 
• **Law Commissioner:**
 
 
• The Law Commission of India is a non-statutory body constituted by the Government of India from time to time.
 
• The Commission is reconstituted every three years and is usually headed by a retired judge of the Supreme Court or a retired Chief Justice of a High Court.
 
• The main function of the Law Commission is to work for legal reforms and its recommendations are not binding on the government.
 
 
 
• **Law Minister:**
 
 
• The Ministry of Law and Justice is an executive body under the Government of India.
 
• The Ministry is responsible for the administration of legal affairs, legislative activities, and the administration of justice in India.
 
• The current Law Minister of India, as of the latest update, is Arjun Ram Meghwal.
 
 
 
• **The Advocate-General for the State:**
 
 
• The Advocate General for the State is the chief legal advisor to the state government as well as the primary lawyer in the High Court.
 
• This position is analogous to that of the Attorney General of India and is covered under Article 165 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Advocate-General is appointed by the Governor of the state and holds office during the pleasure of the Governor.
